requirements.name: backend-curated codex notice allowlist
key UX: The backend only converts the following Codex notifications into user-facing notices: configWarning, deprecationNotice, windows/worldWritableWarning, account/updated, skills/changed, app/list/updated, fs/changed, thread/compacted, and turn/plan/updated.
Low-signal or debug-heavy Codex notifications do not surface as user-facing notices.
The session notice channel remains intentionally curated instead of a broad pass-through of many possible Codex events.

requirements.name: notice semantics stay stable across bootstrap and stream updates
key UX: Allowed notices continue to flow through the existing session notice state so bootstrap snapshots and live SSE updates stay consistent.
Notice ids remain stable enough for reducer upsert behavior, preventing duplicate copies of the same backend notice during streaming.
turn/plan/updated remains part of the notice payload because the frontend still needs it as the source for the standalone todo-list panel.

requirements.name: remove transcript-level notice rendering
key UX: The chat transcript no longer renders generic SessionNotice blocks at the top of the message area.
The transcript surface stops accepting and rendering generic notices inline with chat content.
This avoids duplicated presentation where transcript content and a second app-level notice surface report the same event family.

requirements.name: session notices render in a dedicated toast-style region
key UX: Session notices render in a dedicated session-toast region outside the transcript.
The toast region only reflects backend session notices and does not absorb unrelated action-blocking messages.
Toast styling is distinct from transcript cards and blocking states, preserving a clean app-level feedback surface.

requirements.name: workspace switch blocking feedback stays outside the session toast stream
key UX: Workspace-switch blocking reasons are treated as action feedback rather than as session notices.
Blocking reasons do not appear in the session-toast region alongside backend notices.
This keeps the session-toast stream limited to backend-curated notices instead of mixing durable interaction guards into the same surface.

requirements.name: todo-list notices stay out of the session toast region when promoted into the todo panel
key UX: turn/plan/updated notices continue to drive the standalone todo-list panel for the active thread.
Any notice consumed by the todo-list presentation layer is excluded from the session-toast region so the same plan update is not shown twice.
This preserves todo-list promotion behavior while keeping the remaining visible notices in the app-level toast surface.

requirements.name: delete obsolete feedback-card notice plumbing
key UX: The app removes the old transcript notice rendering path and any component wiring that only existed to support those inline notice cards.
Generic feedback components remain reusable for other product states, but chat notices are modeled and named as toasts rather than as banners.
Tests assert session-toast behavior and todo-list filtering instead of the older banner-oriented naming.
